question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Diminutive
solution:
The correct answer is **"Miniature."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Diminutive"** means much smaller than usual. (सामान्‍य से काफ़ी छोटा, नन्‍हा)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **diminutive**__ statue was only a few inches tall.*
 
 
 
• Synonym of **Diminutive** is **Miniature**.
 
• **"Miniature"** means a small copy of something which is much larger. (बड़े आकार की वस्‍तु का लघु रूप)
 __
 
• **Example**:* This is a **miniature**__ camera.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Enormous** means something very large in size. (विशाल या अत्‍यधिक)
 
• **Option 3: Propaganda** means information and ideas that may be false or exaggerated, which are used to gain support for a political leader, party, etc. ((राजनीतिक नेता, दल आदि के लिए समर्थन जुटाने में प्रयुक्त) असत्‍य या अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण जानकारी और विचार; मतप्रचार, दुष्‍प्रचार)
 
• **Option 4: Distinguish** means to recognize or differentiate between things. (दो वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों में अंतर पहचानना)
